query: SELECT b.id, b.status, b.start_date, b.end_date, b.total_price, v.make, v.model, p.status as payment_status FROM bookings b JOIN vehicles v ON b.vehicle_id = v.id LEFT JOIN payments p ON b.id = p.booking_id ORDER BY b.created_at DESC LIMIT 5;
